verdict.rationale: Discord's developer docs show bots, webhooks, and the Gateway API which let a developer build a bot/integration that runs autonomously in the background and reacts to events, satisfying the technical requirement for background automation. However, this requires building/hosting a custom bot via OAuth2/tokens rather than an AI-native user simply configuring an automation within Discord itself — there's no no-code 'automation builder' feature evidenced for end users. Missing for 10: a first-party no-code automation/workflow feature accessible to non-developer users, and any evidence of AI-specific automation tooling or hands-on confirmation that such bots run reliably unattended.
